author: iamericpereira
text: OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber found 948 Linux root exploits. Each one cost about $1,280. The 30-hour run cost $1.21 million in API credits. It scores 48.5% on ExploitGym, up from 32.1%. Access is limited to vetted Daybreak Red teams.

author: WorldCyberNewsX
text: Anthropic reports an unreleased Claude model independently chained vulnerabilities into working exploits for Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and Linux, including a one-click Chrome sandbox escape.

author: iDrJoee
text: OpenAI rates GPT-6 Cyber Critical under the Preparedness Framework and still ships it. ExploitGym 48.5% vs 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber; 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities; stayed in scope 99.93%.

author: awais_khawar
text: Mozilla says GPT-6 Cyber found novel Firefox vulnerabilities with reproducible patches. The strongest case for AI in security is not alert volume but reproducible findings on a codebase that is already hardened.

author: ZetsubosenseiG
text: Postman desktop update silently installed plugins into Claude Code and Codex; in Codex it added a SessionStart hook instructing the agent. Treat hooks and MCP installs as supply chain.

author: Sujeet
text: Malicious browser extensions can push Claude Desktop to run code locally. Research shows a path from a compromised extension to remote commands across corporate boundaries; Anthropic calls it the extension's problem.

author: AdamDudleyX
text: Pillar Security showed a remote MCP server could run code on OpenCode during OAuth sign-in (Windows and WSL, 1.0.137 to 1.18.32, fixed in 1.18.33). No CVE assigned.

author: rootkitnull
text: CVE-2026-123783: Skyvern through 1.0.56 contains a sandbox bypass that allows authenticated users to execute code by reconstructing functions from raw bytecode with types.CodeType, evading the is_safe_script_code AST denylist.

author: exploitgrid
text: Langflow CVE-2026-0770 (CVSS 9.8): unauthenticated RCE with root privileges, now in CISA KEV. Affects versions up to 1.7.3.

author: AgentSecIndex
text: GitBook's postmortem on its Nov 2 breach: an SSO login flaw let an attacker act as staff, a misconfigured GitHub App led to a Cloudflare API key and production secrets. GitBook says the speed pointed to automation and AI. Customers: new API tokens, rotate integration secrets.

author: BleepinComputer
text: Chainalysis says breach exposed credentials for all customers — names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens. Reset passwords and rotate API keys.

author: EHackerNews
text: Chainalysis says cyber breach exposed user data and authentication tokens due to an agentic attack.

author: canarytrapinc
text: Website chatbots connected to knowledge bases or customer records can leak data via prompt injection; treat them as internet-facing apps in scope.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: ReliaQuest says it is using Anthropic’s Claude Mythos for defensive testing: attack-path discovery, exploit development, attacker-behavior prediction, detection review, remediation prioritization.

author: mezzframe
text: Wireshark's September releases fix many vulnerabilities due to the recent trend in AI-assisted vulnerability reports.

author: Arindam_1729
text: Glow Labs mcphantom pattern: coding agents install deprecated MCP servers on developer machines; in 98% of reviewed sessions the installed software would never get patched.

author: jenobix
text: OpenSSH has fixed a critical password bypass ("sshole", CVE-2026-123158). On Linux servers using musl without PAM (Alpine's default), a very long password can log in to some accounts. No attacks reported yet, but test exploits are public.

author: infrastack_ai
text: OpenSSH sshd on musl Linux: the password check can be bypassed, and exploit code is out. Affects Alpine defaults including some AWS/Azure images.

author: surajpathakcs
text: Microsoft Paint RCE CVE-2026-83844: if your MS Paint version is below 11.2609.401.0, you are still affected. Fix is via Microsoft Store, not Windows Update.

author: thecyberseckyle
text: Windows patched? Check Paint too. CVE-2026-83844 is a Microsoft Paint RCE flaw fixed through the Microsoft Store, not Windows Update. Verify Paint 11.2609.401.0+. No known exploitation.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical SAML Bypass in Keycloak (CVE-2026-117691, CVSS 9.1). HTTP-Redirect processes percent-encoded parameter names while signature checks only verify literal names, enabling SSO takeover. Patch Keycloak.

author: cvedotnow
text: Gitea: 3 critical CVEs. Worst: account takeover in OAuth2 (CVE-2026-120263). Patch to 28.3.0.

author: 0xmrma_
text: Clone2Creds / CVE-2026-62960: zero-day in Git for Windows. Clone a repository and attacker can capture credentials. Full writeup and exploit published.

author: CloudDoctrineHQ
text: Cisco confirms two critical PHP RCE flaws (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619), tracked as PHP2shell, affect Expressway, URWB and Duo Access Gateway. Patches available.

author: cvedotnow
text: Google-Auth: server-side request forgery in AWS external account config (CVE-2026-74759). Attacker can make the library send requests to internal services and cloud metadata endpoints. No patch listed yet.

author: EnclaveRadar
text: CVE-2026-59105 (CVSS 9.8): Universal sysadmin credential vulnerability in Jumis. Jumis creates a SQL Server login ##Tilde_JumisAdmin## that is a sysadmin; remote, no login needed.

author: CCBalert
text: Critical CVE-2026-122006 (CVSS 9.8) affects Ruby on Rails Active Storage, allowing unauthenticated attackers to read and write server files via malicious image uploads processed by ImageMagick.

author: ptdbugs
text: Command Execution via WordPress Pingback and Brotli: WordPress pingback can reach CVE-2026-111497 in the native Brotli decoder (out-of-bounds write affecting Node.js, Envoy, Bun, .NET, Python).

author: thiscitze
text: CVE-2026-113615 — GS JWT (WordPress) <= 1.0.0: Unauthenticated SQLi in /wp-json/gs-jwt/v1/verify-otp. A UNION SELECT makes the plugin sign a JWT for any user id: admin token, full takeover. CVSS 9.8. PoC published.

author: xer0dayz
text: XSS2Shell CVE-2026-64638: Nuclei Template + Affected Versions published.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Update Veeam Software Appliance and Backup & Replication servers now to fix CVE-2026-98432, a critical 9.8 CVSS Linux kernel flaw.

author: vuldb
text: Important vulnerability affecting Apache James (CVE-2025-66621) added to VulDB.

author: MisconfigMonday
text: VMware ESX: CISA added CVE-2026-41709 to KEV. Part of Broadcom VMSA-2026-0006; on ESX 8.0 go to 8.0 U3k which also fixes a critical bug.

author: MilitarySummary
text: A cyberattack has destroyed the cloud infrastructure of Beget — one of Russia's largest hosting providers. Beget hosts over 330,000 websites.

author: icpbenja
text: Hosting provider Beget confirms that all data across its cloud infrastructure (VPS, S3, and Kubernetes) has been lost following a massive cyberattack.

author: kirstenrpomales
text: Gnosis Pay data breach: some personal information accessed including names, addresses, and for some cards full numbers, expiry, and CVVs. Cards cancelled; no fund losses detected.

author: oost_marcel
text: Nubank has reportedly suspended crypto deposits and withdrawals following a security incident at a technology provider (Chainalysis).

author: TrustMountAI
text: Defender checklist (CrowdStrike): Rotate keys after any directory/export leak; enforce SAML signatures; IMDSv2; least-privilege cloud roles; hunt artx/artex CLI markers; patch internet-facing Linux.

author: PumpkinSecurity
text: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Cyber That Finds 81 Firefox Flaws and Develops 948 Linux Exploits. Security-focused AI model discovered 81 new high-severity Firefox flaws.

author: NeuralNewscast
text: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, rated Critical under its Preparedness Framework, capable of identifying zero-day exploits without human intervention.
